name: v0 by Vercel (v0.app)
siteVersion: host v0.app (SSR over /chat-static/_next/static/immutable/chunks, Turbopack build); v0.dev 301-redirects here; homepage title 'v0 by Vercel - Build Full-Stack Web Apps with AI'

capabilities.name: Chat stream
capabilities.description: Composer send via POST /chat/api/chat (Accept text/event-stream, body parsed as newline-delimited JSON reduced into assistant message state; resume via GET /chat/api/chat/resume?messageId=, probe HEAD resume/ping). Request body: messageContent MdX parts, modelConfiguration {modelId, imageGenerations, thinking}, attachments, sandbox, permissionsMode
capabilities.method: ui-path (ProseMirror composer + Enter, site's own send handler) — WIRE-VERIFIED / LIVE-SHAPE-TO-VERIFY

capabilities.name: Agent workspace / build VM
capabilities.description: Build sandbox lifecycle: /chat/api/vm/status|git|actions/recreate|actions/run-pipeline, /api/v2/internal/chats/:chatId/agent-workspace/* (acquire, browser, code-server, preview-intents, projects/:id/diff, services/:name/logs), [ws-console] WebSocket log stream

capabilities.name: Artifact preview (generated UI frames)
capabilities.description: Preview plumbing verified: GET /chat/api/chat/frame-token?cid=&vid=&bid=&tcid= (frame session token), /chat/api/chat/leaf, /chat/api/chat/download?url=. Whether AI-generated preview artifacts are visible/readable in an automated capture is NOT yet confirmed
capabilities.method: site frame/iframe (code evidence only) — TO-VERIFY on first live capture

capabilities.name: Deployments & publishing
capabilities.description: POST /api/v2/internal/deployments/ and POST /api/v2/internal/chats/:chatId/publish — SSE text/event-stream with verified object schemas (publish.progress/publish.result, deployment.progress/deployment.log/deployment.created, error); logs/errors/screenshot getters per deployment

capabilities.name: Image generation
capabilities.description: imageGenerations boolean + imageGeneration:{modelId} on the chat payload; reasoning-effort enum none|minimal|low|medium|high|max|xhigh; catalog GET /api/v2/internal/image-models

auth.note: provider-catalog: v0-vercel-web kind=cookie credentialName=__vercel_session. Login redirects to /api/auth/login?next=<path> (GitHub/Vercel OAuth branding on the landing page); POST /api/auth/update exists. Chat/API calls are same-origin; NO document.cookie writes or Authorization Bearer literals in the app bundles (cookies are httpOnly/browser-managed — exact cookie set to be recorded from a live session). Requests carry a `scope` (team/project slug) arg on many endpoints; artifacts/frames additionally gated by a token from /chat/api/chat/frame-token. Capture once headed, then fill session.lock.json.

analysisMethod: static curl + 9 JS bundles (~4.8MB) + SSR page (v0.dev -> v0.app redirect resolved); no browser launched
